status: declared 2026-10-30 before the round-4 campaigns (consolidated R4-BTS tasks); the BTS lattice is not changed
inherits: round3_protocol.json: aperture model, error model, steering algorithm, exit targets; exact round-aperture loss (R4-BTS-03)
frozen_settings: reference and low_beta from round 2; robust from results/bts_journal_campaign_r3b_20261015/robust/robust.json
beam_units_note: At m1 the rms beam is 0.379 mm / 91 urad (with dispersion); at m4 sigma_x = 0.159 mm. Jitter scale 1 is 0.5 mm / 0.2 mrad (1.3 / 2.2 beam sizes at m1); scale 0.1 is 13 % / 22 %.

jitter.scaled: position and angle jitter together; centroid momentum jitter 0.1 % unchanged
jitter.observable: analytic Gaussian loss on steered realizations (mean over the sampled shots), the jitter-integrated loss of each steered realization (exact Gaussian average over entrance jitter, no shot sampling), and the error-free shot-averaged loss (no particle tracking)
jitter.amendment: 2026-10-30: the jitter-integrated observable was added after the first jitter/blade runs (directories jitter/ and blade/, retained) showed that the sampled 600-shot mean cannot resolve small losses; the reruns are jitter_b/ and blade_b/

blade.realizations: same seeds as the jitter stage (paired)
blade.observable: analytic Gaussian loss, steered realizations and error-free line; tolerance distance from the jitter-integrated loss by log-linear interpolation

phase_scan.starts: 6 pool solutions nearest in mu_x (round-3 phase pools) plus 4 uniform random starts per grid point
phase_scan.amendment: 2026-10-31: the first run (6 + 10 starts, 3000 evaluations each) was stopped after 26 min without output because unreachable grid points exhaust the budget on every start; it is retained as phase_scan/ (configuration only). The rerun phase_scan_b/ uses 6 + 4 starts and 600 evaluations; pool starts converge within about 200.
phase_scan.solver: bounded least squares on the six scaled exit residuals plus (mu_x - target)/0.01 rad; accepted if every scaled residual < 1e-4
phase_scan.selection: per grid point the matched solution with the smallest larger peak beta (16 subdivisions); feasible if both peaks <= 60 m
phase_scan.edges: SLSQP minimising and maximising mu_x subject to the six exit equalities, K bounds and both peak betas <= 60 m, from the five pool solutions nearest each edge; active constraints reported
phase_scan.chosen: feasible configured-target scan solution with the smallest error-free shot-averaged loss (scan_best), and likewise for the dispersion-free target (free_best)
phase_scan.scope: sampled search with explicit edge optimisation; not a proof of global reachability

steering_layouts.definitions: src/nkm_injection/bts_round4.py LAYOUTS; reduced monitors read the exits of q13, q23 and q33 plus the septum entrance and line end; series bends trim b1-b3 as one knob with kicks proportional to bending angle
steering_layouts.bpm_noise: one static reading error per candidate monitor point, seeded by [bpm_seed, machine, design_index] as in round 3; layouts use the subset they read
steering_layouts.reproduction_check: full layout, reference design must reproduce the round-3 steering row
steering_layouts.amendment: 2026-10-31: a first layouts/ run was stopped together with the first phase scan before producing output (configuration only, retained); the stage is run as layouts_b/

final_test.amendment: 2026-10-31, before any test output: edge_best (the converged SLSQP solution of smallest mu_x for the configured exit, phase_scan_b edges) is added, because the loss decreases monotonically towards that edge and the grid point scan_best (202 deg) lies 1.8 deg inside it. A first final_test/ directory from the stopped run holds only its configuration; the test is run as final_test_b/.
final_test.frozen_before_test: scan_best and free_best are frozen in phase_scan.json before this stage runs
